project.name: ToolboxPro
project.description: 100+ free client-side online tools across 8 categories. Zero server processing — everything runs in the browser via JavaScript/Canvas/WebAssembly. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Bilingual (EN/ZH) with 30+ blog posts for SEO.

nodes.name: Home Page
nodes.summary: Client-side home page with Hero section, PopularTools pills, Category grid, All tools grid, Latest blog posts, Why ToolboxPro section. Uses i18n for all text.

nodes.name: Tool Page (Server)
nodes.summary: Server component for individual tool pages. Generates static params for all tools, dynamic metadata per tool. Delegates rendering to ToolPageContent.

nodes.name: Tool Page Content
nodes.summary: Client component that imports and dynamically renders 100+ tool components via getToolComponent(). Shows breadcrumb, tool widget, related tools, related blog posts.

nodes.name: Blog Post Page (Server)
nodes.summary: Server component for blog posts. Generates static params, dynamic metadata with article schema. Delegates to BlogPostContent.

nodes.name: i18n Context
nodes.summary: React context for internationalization. Provides locale state (en/zh), setLocale, and t() translation function with dot-notation key lookup and parameter interpolation. Persists to localStorage.

nodes.name: Header Component
nodes.summary: Sticky header with logo, category navigation (desktop), blog link, language switcher (EN/ZH toggle), dark mode toggle, mobile menu. Uses lucide-react icons.

nodes.name: Footer Component
nodes.summary: Multi-column footer with featured tools, more tools, company links (about, contact, blog, privacy, terms), tagline, copyright, visitor counter, theme toggle.

nodes.name: Theme Provider
nodes.summary: next-themes wrapper for dark/light mode. Provides useTheme() hook to read and toggle theme state.

nodes.name: Error Boundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary component that catches rendering errors in tool components and shows a fallback UI instead of crashing the page.

nodes.name: Cookie Banner
nodes.summary: GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner. Shows on first visit, stores consent in localStorage.

nodes.name: Favorites
nodes.summary: Tool favorites management. Stores favorite tool slugs in localStorage, provides add/remove/check functions.

nodes.name: Visitor Counter
nodes.summary: Client-side visitor counter using Vercel KV store. Displays visit count in the footer.

nodes.name: Tool Widget
nodes.summary: Reusable wrapper component for individual tool pages. Provides consistent card styling with title, border, shadow effects.

nodes.name: Ad Unit
nodes.summary: Google AdSense ad component. Uses NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT env var for ad client ID. Responsive ad slots.

nodes.name: JSON Formatter Tool
nodes.summary: Client-side JSON formatter and validator. Parses, beautifies, minifies JSON with error highlighting.

nodes.name: Base64 Tool
nodes.summary: Client-side Base64 encoder/decoder for text and file content.

nodes.name: Image Compressor Tool
nodes.summary: Client-side image compression using Canvas API. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP formats.

nodes.name: PDF Merger Tool

nodes.name: QR Code Generator Tool

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: ToolboxPro is a Next.js 15 website with 100+ client-side tools across 8 categories. Everything runs in the browser — no server processing. Built with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.

tour.title: Root Layout & Providers
tour.description: The app starts with the root layout at app/layout.tsx which wraps everything in ThemeProvider, LocaleProvider, and renders Header/Footer. SEO metadata is defined here.

tour.title: Navigation System
tour.description: Header component provides category navigation, blog link, language switcher (EN/ZH), and dark mode toggle. Footer shows tool links, company pages, and visitor counter.

tour.title: Home Page
tour.description: The home page (app/page.tsx) displays a hero section with search, popular tools pills, category grid, all tools grid, latest blog posts, and value proposition sections.

tour.title: Tools Architecture
tour.description: Tools are defined in lib/tools/data.ts with slug, name, category, icon, and searchKeywords. Each tool has a dedicated page at /tools/[slug] with its own React component in _components/.

tour.title: Individual Tool Pages
tour.description: Tool pages use a server component (page.tsx) for static generation and metadata, then delegate to a client component (tool-page-content.tsx) that imports the specific tool component via a component map.

tour.title: Blog System
tour.description: Blog posts are stored in lib/blog/data.ts with bilingual content. Each post links to a tool via toolSlug. Pages at /blog and /blog/[slug] use static generation.

tour.title: Internationalization
tour.description: i18n uses React Context with English and Chinese dictionaries. The t() function supports dot-notation keys and parameter interpolation. Locale is persisted in localStorage.

tour.title: Static Pages & SEO
tour.description: Static pages (about, contact, privacy, terms) serve legal/compliance needs. SEO is handled via Next.js metadata API, sitemap.ts, robots.ts, and schema.org JSON-LD in the root layout.

tour.title: Build & Dev Tooling
tour.description: Python scripts automate tool generation, content translation, and category management. Node.js scripts handle blog translation. CI pipeline verifies builds on GitHub.
